coverageDispositions.name: DNS, discovery, network paths and sockets
coverageDispositions.reason: No network, resolver or socket path in this local SQLite worker.

coverageDispositions.name: TLS, certificates and transport identity
coverageDispositions.reason: No transport or certificates; no TLS boundary in this fixture.

coverageDispositions.name: Proxies, gateways, ingress, CDN and load balancing
coverageDispositions.reason: CLI and direct local module calls have no proxy or ingress.

coverageDispositions.name: Authentication, authorization and tenant identity
coverageDispositions.reason: Trusted local caller/file boundary; tenant or authentication service is absent and not requested.

coverageDispositions.name: API styles, HTTP versions, RPC and streams
coverageDispositions.reason: Preserve module/CLI interface; no HTTP, RPC or streaming service.

coverageDispositions.name: CRUD, upsert and bulk semantics
coverageDispositions.reason: Durable enqueue binds job identity; equal replay accepts and conflicting reuse rejects.

coverageDispositions.name: Validation, parsing, serialization and errors
coverageDispositions.reason: Validate IDs, known accounts, safe positive integers; structured failure codes and failed poison state.

coverageDispositions.name: Domain architecture and request lifecycle
coverageDispositions.reason: Pending/effect-ledger/done lifecycle and separate terminal failure; transaction owns the local effect.

coverageDispositions.name: Runtime, memory, concurrency, OS and containers
coverageDispositions.reason: One active worker; one job per call; finally closes CLI DB, bounded diagnostic materialization and child timeouts.

coverageDispositions.name: Database modeling and DDL
coverageDispositions.reason: Add per-job credit ledger primary key/FKs, attempts/error columns and pending index.

coverageDispositions.name: DML/DQL, ORM, indexes and query plans
coverageDispositions.reason: Parameterized statements and indexed pending/identity queries; no ORM or performance claim.

coverageDispositions.name: Transactions, isolation, locks and consistency
coverageDispositions.reason: BEGIN IMMEDIATE effect+ledger transaction with rollback; separate acknowledgement reconciles committed effects.

coverageDispositions.name: Database privileges and operational administration
coverageDispositions.reason: SQLite file/OS trust boundary has no SQL role/grant administration; production permissions are not requested or verified.

coverageDispositions.name: Storage, replication, partitioning, sharding and hashes
coverageDispositions.reason: Local durable ledger and synchronous FULL; actual same-file process restart tested, no replication/sharding claim.

coverageDispositions.name: Cache, views and derived state
coverageDispositions.reason: No cache, materialized view or asynchronous projection is introduced.

coverageDispositions.name: Messaging, event logs, CDC and async effects
coverageDispositions.reason: Local durable enqueue/replay and effect-before-ack failure boundary; no broker or external delivery guarantee.

coverageDispositions.name: Durable workers, schedules and workflows
coverageDispositions.reason: Durable job identity, bounded persistent attempts, terminal failure and crash reconciliation.

coverageDispositions.name: Files, objects, search and specialized stores
coverageDispositions.reason: SQLite is covered as the selected DB; no upload/object/search/specialized store path.

coverageDispositions.name: External APIs, webhooks, tools and MCP
coverageDispositions.reason: No remote API, webhook, MCP adapter or external effect.

coverageDispositions.name: Traffic, capacity, scaling and cost
coverageDispositions.reason: At most one pending job and three effect attempts; finite diagnostic output; explicitly unbounded total retained queue.

coverageDispositions.name: Reliability, backups and recovery
coverageDispositions.reason: Three actual process crashes and usable same-file restart plus rollback recovery tested; backup/DR not claimed.

coverageDispositions.name: Observability, objectives and audit
coverageDispositions.reason: Persistent job attempts/error and bounded structured CLI snapshots expose done/failed outcomes.

coverageDispositions.name: Infrastructure, build and deployment lifecycle
coverageDispositions.reason: Executable original-style CLI and native Node version verified; no dependency downloads, build or deployment.

coverageDispositions.name: Security, privacy, supply chain and lifecycle
coverageDispositions.reason: Bounded validated inputs and parameterized SQL; trusted local file/direct-writer limitation documented.

decisions.mechanism: Validate exact ID/account/amount, check known account, and compare durable job parameters inside BEGIN IMMEDIATE; bind SQL values.
decisions.limit: IDs<=256 UTF-8 bytes, accounts<=128 bytes, positive safe integer amount; local trusted callers.
decisions.failure: Invalid payload rejects without enqueue; conflicting ID raises JOB_CONFLICT; direct SQL bypass is trusted/outside API.
decisions.verification: File reopen replay, amount/account conflict, invalid payload checks in evidence/verification.json

decisions.mechanism: Balance update and unique job credit ledger insert commit together before real process.exit(73) hook; matching ledger reconciles to done.
decisions.limit: One SQLite database, one active worker, only local balance effect; retain identities indefinitely.
decisions.failure: Crash after commit leaves pending+credit; restart acknowledges without recredit. External effects and pre-repair unledgered effects require separate reconciliation.
decisions.verification: Three actual crash exit73/restart exit0 runs and persisted SQL observations in evidence/verification.json

decisions.mechanism: Revalidate pending jobs; invalid payload or unsafe total becomes failed; rollback effect+ledger on storage errors; CLI finally closes DB.
decisions.limit: A bounded safe-integer balance; three effect attempts; transaction cleanup assumes DB remains writable.
decisions.failure: Poison job never silently becomes done; storage failure propagates and later healthy job remains processable; disk failure not tested.
decisions.verification: Legacy invalid rows, post-effect callback failure and injected ledger-trigger rollback/recovery in evidence/verification.json

decisions.mechanism: One pending job per runOne/CLI invocation, persistent attempt cap3, no retry loop; existing ledger reconciles before retry limit.
decisions.limit: 250ms busy timeout per acquisition, output100 rows/table; no total queue quota or hard wall deadline.
decisions.failure: After three effect errors job is failed; caller must reinvoke for retries; corrupt ledger mismatch requires manual repair.
decisions.verification: One-job checks and three injected storage failures in evidence/verification.json; limits documented in artifact/README.md

decisions.mechanism: Built-in test script uses native file-backed SQLite and spawned real CLI; preserve child status/stdout/stderr and all coverage/decision trace.
decisions.limit: Node24.12.0 SQLite3.50.4 Windows x64 tested; no downloads/network/production action.
decisions.failure: Required failing checks remain FAIL; unsupported production/distributed outcomes are explicit limitations.

assumptions: Exactly one active worker; no stale concurrent owner or external broker.
Trusted local caller and DB file/direct SQL writers.
Repeated invocation is required to drain more than one job or retry recoverable storage failures.
Normal local SQLite commit/filesystem behavior; restart test does not establish power-loss guarantees.
limitations: No distributed exactly-once claim, remote effect, production deployment, networking or downloads.
Original already-applied effects without ledger cannot be inferred; manually reconcile pre-repair databases.
No automatic purge: jobs/ledger retained indefinitely for durable identity, storage and total queue grow with admitted jobs.
No power-loss/disk-full/backup restore/multi-worker/OS-permission/load verification; no production performance or throughput claim.
Node emits experimental SQLite warning; raw crash child warnings retained.
